1.consolidated_definition: No saber nada. “Cuando llegó a su casa, todavía no sabía un divino de lo que estaba ocurriendo allí.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be utterly unaware or uninformed about something. "When he arrived home, he still had no idea what was happening there."
